subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission handshake, tokenized ACKs & email fallback
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hart <sara.hart@vertex-payments.com>, Payments Ops <payments-ops@vertex-payments.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission handshake, tokenized ACKs & email fallback

Hi Sara —

Thanks for starting vendor onboarding. A couple of practical questions from our AP onboarding checklist so we can give clear guidance to our vendors:

1) Portal-first preference with an email fallback: we prefer vendors upload to the portal, but we support SMTP/email fallback if the vendor cannot use the portal. If email is used, we require a subject token for automatic routing. Is that possible on your side?

2) ACK semantics: do you provide an asynchronous acknowledgement token (a short opaque token we can include in the subject or header) on successful ingest? If so, can you share the token format and SLA for ACK issuance (e.g., 30s, 5m)?

3) PO mapping multientity rules: our customers sometimes send multi-entity POs. We need to know whether your ingestion accepts PO at the line level, or only in the invoice header, and how you surface mapping errors back to the vendor.

I've attached our completed onboarding-form.pdf to speed the activation.

If easier, we can do a 30-minute sync this afternoon — I'll loop in Vanessa who manages procurement for this region.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

Attachment: onboarding-form.pdf (application/pdf, 489KB)

From: Sara Hart <sara.hart@vertex-payments.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Payments Ops <payments-ops@vertex-payments.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission handshake, tokenized ACKs & email fallback

Hi Naomi —

Great to meet you over email. Short answers up front:
- Yes, portal-first is fine. We also support SMTP submission for vendors that cannot integrate.
- We can emit an ingestion ACK token. Format is a 12-char alphanumeric token we return in a JSON ack payload or in an email header depending on the channel. Typical issuance SLA is ~45s for portal uploads and ~3–5 minutes for SMTP ingestion during peak.
- PO mapping: we accept PO at header level (preferred) and line-level if the vendor supplies a structured CSV. For unstructured PDFs we run OCR and can return explicit line-level mapping errors to the vendor via a status webhook or an email with error details.

Attaching our quick spec (vertex_sample_ack_specs.pdf) with token examples and the HTTP webhook payload we can call for async status.

We can join a 30-min session — proposed slots: 14:00 or 15:00 PT.

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Hart
Integrations Lead, Vertex Payments
sara.hart@vertex-payments.com

Attachment: vertex_sample_ack_specs.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hart <sara.hart@vertex-payments.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission handshake, tokenized ACKs & email fallback

Thanks Sara — that helps a lot. A few follow-ups and constraints from our side so we can finalize vendor instructions: 

• Email fallback subject token: we will ask vendors to include a token in the subject in the form RW-<vendor-id>-<document-type>-<uuid>. Example: RW-ACME-INV-1a2b3c. We need your SMTP ingestion to preserve subject tokens verbatim and return the ACK token either in the response email subject (OK: RW-ACK <ack-token>) or in an email header X-Vertex-Ack. Can you support both?

• ACK SLA tolerance: portal 60s (we can tolerate up to 60s), SMTP best-effort up to 5m. If ACKs exceed 5m we want an automated escalation email to our procurement queue.

• PO mapping: for multi-entity POs we will send PO entity_id in the CSV line as vendor_entity_id. If you cannot accept line-level entity_id we will instead split invoices per entity. Please confirm whether you prefer split invoices or a CSV with vendor_entity_id per line.

• Error reporting: prefer webhook for status, but email status to vendor/payables is acceptable for small partners.

Attached: example_invoice_rows.csv (sample header + two rows) — please confirm the minimal headers you require for CSV ingestion.

If this looks fine, we'll document the subject token convention in vendor onboarding instructions and provide a short template vendors can paste into their accounting system. Vanessa — can you confirm the PO policy (split vs per-line)?

—Naomi

Attachment: example_invoice_rows.csv (text/csv, 2KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sara Hart <sara.hart@vertex-payments.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission handshake, tokenized ACKs & email fallback

Thanks team — good progress. Procurement policy notes: 

- For multi-entity POs we prefer invoices split by legal entity where feasible. That reduces GL reconciliation time on our side. If the vendor can include vendor_entity_id per line in CSV, that is acceptable, but operationally split invoices is the default ask.
- Required PO presence: PO number must be included in header OR as a dedicated PO field in CSV. If a vendor sends a PDF without PO, we'll route to exceptions and require manual remediation.
- SLA/credits: we won't require vendor-level credits for ACK latency in onboarding, but we need the 5m alerting rule in place so our ops queue can follow up.

Next step: I suggest a short 30-minute call to show the vendor the subject-token pattern and agree webhook vs email. Sara — Naomi proposed 14:00 or 15:00 PT; we can do 15:00 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-vertex-onboard-30m

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

See you at 15:00 PT.

Sara
